lang_quotes.author: Wang Zuoliang

lang_quotes.target: Translation is a cultural rewriting that shapes the imagination of the other.
lang_quotes.author: Xie Tianzhen

lang_quotes.target: The so-called "original" is often a product of the translation process itself.
lang_quotes.author: Xie Tianzhen

lang_quotes.target: The institutional framework of "national language" is first constructed through the act of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Linguistic homogeneity is nothing more than a fantasy fabricated after the fact.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The communality of "we" is fabricated through the constant work of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Linguistic boundaries do not exist before translation; they are produced by it.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Universality is a fiction that can only be acquired as a result of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Language is a system of signs and, at the same time, an apparatus of power.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The faith in "mother tongue" is maintained by erasing the traces of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Linguistic identity is constructed through the mirror of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The meaning of the original is fabricated only through the repetition of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The modern view of translation perceives language as the property of a closed community.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is a violent rebirth that brings past texts back to life within a current context.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: A translator is one who lives multiple historical times simultaneously.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The end of translation is always the beginning of a new misreading.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is not a bridge, but an act that transforms the landscape of both shores.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The concept of "mother tongue" is first created through the act of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is a condition of its possibility before it is a means of communication.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: A translator is a boundary being who stands between two languages but belongs to neither.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is an ethical event of encountering an undetermined other.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The impossibility of translation is the very driving force that makes translation possible.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is not an act of making the other's voice one's own, but an act of othering the self.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The translator is destined to be always exiled to the outside of the community.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The politics of translation asks who speaks for whom.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Asymmetrical power relations always intervene at the site of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is the only way for heterogeneous things to coexist.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The labor of translation is not about pursuing equivalence of value, but about producing difference.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The subject in translation is always split and cannot be single.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: The purpose of translation is not the confirmation of identity, but the affirmation of hybridity.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: World literature is a political product that has passed through the filter of translation.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is always the institutionalization of a "misreading".
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Translation is an infinite gesture toward an impossible agreement.
lang_quotes.author: Naoki Sakai

lang_quotes.target: Rather be faithful than smooth.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: This "hard translation" is inevitable for the sake of precision.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: This lack of smoothness is intended to cause unease in the reader.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: One must sacrifice the reader's comfort for the sake of precision.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: The translator's task is to bring in foreign things.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: Rather be un-smooth due to faithfulness than be distorted due to smoothness.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: Even "hard translation" is better than "reckless translation".
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: This "hard translation" is like a major surgery.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: If there were no translation, China would not be as advanced as it is now.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: We must not only bring it in but also digest it.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: Translating books is transport, introduction, and also an attack.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: Translation is opening the way for future generations.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: Translators are the thieves of fire for culture.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun

lang_quotes.target: All translation must consider both sides: striving for ease of understanding while preserving the spirit of the original.
lang_quotes.author: Lu Xun
